title: States for the quarterly GSTR-3B
description: The GST State codes in the two lists of the Table of rule 61(1)(ii) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Rules, 2017, which set the due date of the quarterly GSTR-3B by the State or Union territory of the principal place of business: the twenty-second day of the month after the quarter for the first list and the twenty-fourth for the second. The rule names the Union territories of Daman and Diu and Dadra and Nagar Haveli, not the merged Union territory of code 26, and neither list names Other Territory, code 97, so neither code has a row.

instruments: Notification No. 82/2020-Central Tax, 10 November 2020, Central Goods and Services Tax (Thirteenth Amendment) Rules, 2020, substituting rule 61 from 1 January 2021
